description: Uploads a CSV/XLSX file and starts an import using an existing mapping. The MCP server reads the file from disk — pass an absolute path. Returns the created import object including importId. Status starts as SCHEDULED — poll get_import_status or use wait_for_import. Limits: .csv/.xlsx/.xls only, 50MB max.

entityName.description: Entity to import as — must match list_entities (e.g. 'Journal Entry').

filePath.description: Absolute path to a .csv, .xlsx, or .xls file on the machine running the MCP server.

mappingId.description: Mapping id from list_mappings to apply to the file.

name: execute_import

finishedAt.description: ISO timestamp when reached terminal status, if applicable.

status.description: Lifecycle status (SCHEDULED, IN_PROGRESS, FINISHED, FINISHED_WITH_WARNINGS, FAILED, CANCELED, REVERTING, REVERTED).
